domain: adjudication of the round-2/3 Scout disposition disagreement — whether a read+web/no-write collection half is an unoccupied gate signature, resolved against Skaffen's live gate matrix
axioms: A claimed gate delta is settled by tracing tool registration to the phase map, not by weighing rhetoric.
Web tool registration lives in builtin.go, not defaultGates, so a reader of registry.go alone will miss half the signature.
An enforcement vocabulary with fewer values than the candidate field cannot discriminate it.
primitives: capability vs state vs routing vs authority delta
failure_mode: Settles the enforceability question and can under-serve semantic distinctness.
Risks reading 'no capability delta' as 'no delta of any kind'.
